about: H3f mutants of hosts/mygo and its drawing module. scripts/mutants measures the Ergo module only; each edit here is applied to a scratch copy of the repository without .git (the layout tests build bin/ergo from it; an H2L mutant edits std ui/layout, which only hosts/mygo's oracle holds to MyGo), then, when the edit is to drawing/internal/drawgen, drawgen runs in drawing/ (as go generate would after the edit), then the killers run. A killer is module:Test, where module is drawing or mygo.

mutants.name: H3f-consts-dropped
mutants.rule: every exported constant of a drawing-layer package is mirrored

mutants.name: H3f-args-reordered
mutants.rule: a wrapper calls the internal function with its parameters in order

mutants.name: H3f-layer-dropped
mutants.rule: the export reaches every layer a host draws with

mutants.name: H3f-hand-edit
mutants.rule: the drawing packages are what drawgen writes from the pinned MyGo

mutants.name: H2L-gap-after-last
mutants.rule: a gap goes between children, not after the last

mutants.name: H2L-grow-by-count
mutants.rule: free space is shared by grow weight, not by count

mutants.name: H2L-cross-padding-ignored
mutants.rule: a row places its children inside its padding across the line

mutants.name: H2L-dirty-not-propagated
mutants.rule: a change forgets what the nodes up to the root computed

mutants.name: H2L-no-reuse
mutants.rule: a box laid out at its size with nothing changed in it is kept, not computed again

mutants.name: H3g-hit-first
mutants.from:
if inside(s, x, y) {
				hit = Some{Value: s}
mutants.rule: the hit test takes the node painted last under the point: a button over an Area takes the tap

mutants.name: H3g-tab-reversed
mutants.from: let next = if back { (at + n - 1) % n } else { (at + 1) % n }
mutants.to: let next = if back { (at + 1) % n } else { (at + n - 1) % n }
mutants.rule: Tab moves the focus forward in paint (tree) order, Shift+Tab back

mutants.name: H3g-fill-off-its-box
mutants.to: fill(d, layout.Box{X: b.X, Y: b.Y + 6, W: b.W, H: b.H}, 6, button)
mutants.rule: a node's fill is painted on the box the layout gave it, where the hit test finds it

mutants.name: H3g-backspace-keeps-text
mutants.rule: Backspace in the focused field removes its last rune

mutants.name: H3g-release-dropped
mutants.to:
case Some[spot[E]] as s:
				let _ = s
			case None:
mutants.rule: a release with no press goes to the Area under it

mutants.name: H3g-go-directive-dropped
mutants.rule: a program that binds this module (which needs Go 1.27.3, as MyGo does) builds: the emitted go.mod states the later go version

mutants.name: X-gui-row-below-the-fold-not-scrolled-to
mutants.rule: a step on a row below its Scroll's fold scrolls to it first, as a person does, so it presses that row and not the one painted over its box

mutants.name: X-gui-window-binary-prints-the-start
mutants.rule: the window binary prints the state the window's driver holds after each step

mutants.name: W1-binding-off-the-browser
mutants.rule: the window binaries build for Windows and the browser: screen's binding states windows/amd64 and js/wasm, where it holds (ergo bind go)

mutants.name: GPh-row-at-the-written-index
mutants.rule: a list's row shows at its index's place, counted from the list's First, not from the first row written

mutants.name: GPh-viewport-not-reported
mutants.rule: the window reports a list's viewport, so the next pass writes the rows it shows

mutants.name: GPh-list-gets-no-room
mutants.rule: a list with no height of its own takes the window below its top

mutants.name: GPh-list-not-stretched
mutants.rule: a list is as wide as its parent, and its rows as wide as the list

mutants.name: GPh-scroll-on-does-nothing
mutants.rule: ScrollOn scrolls the list to its offset, or as far as its content goes

mutants.name: GPh-wheel-misses-lists
mutants.from:
case ui.ScrollNode, ui.RowsNode:
				target = Some{Value: s}
mutants.rule: the wheel scrolls the list under the pointer

mutants.name: GPh-canvas-transform-dropped
mutants.from:
stack = stack.Append(pushed{was: m, clip: false})
			m = compose(m, x.M)
mutants.to:
stack = stack.Append(pushed{was: m, clip: false})
			m = compose(m, ui.Scale(x.M.A, x.M.D))
mutants.rule: a canvas paints under the transforms its list pushes

mutants.name: GPh-fill-spans-outside
mutants.rule: a path's fill covers where its winding number is not zero

mutants.name: GP1c-page-keys-unnamed
mutants.rule: the window names the page keys, so a program's OnKey gets PageDown

mutants.name: GP1c-keys-to-the-focused-button
mutants.rule: a key of the table's goes to the table, after a click on the list drops a button's focus

mutants.name: GP1c-list-not-followed
mutants.rule: the window's list scrolls to the table's window after each line

mutants.name: GP1c-typed-without-the-field
mutants.rule: typed text goes into the field, which the window clicks first

mutants.name: GP1c-control-list-not-followed
mutants.rule: the control's window shows the table's window: its list scrolls there after each line (receipts measure that frame)

mutants.name: GP1c-control-list-unbounded
mutants.rule: the control's list is a viewport that scrolls (a growing list in a column of no height is as tall as its rows, and never scrolls)

mutants.name: GPk-rebuilt-every-paint
mutants.rule: the driver keeps its layout tree across paints: a pass lays out what it changed, not the tree

mutants.name: GPk-every-style-set
mutants.rule: a box's style is set only where it differs, so its siblings keep what the kernel computed

mutants.name: GPk-kids-not-reordered
mutants.rule: a parent's boxes follow its children's order from the first that moved

mutants.name: GPk-set-not-learned
mutants.from:
learn(&d.metrics, d.w, textOf(x.Node), textSize)
			match d.lparent.Get(x.Id) {
mutants.rule: a node's new text is measured before the kept tree lays it out

mutants.name: GPk-set-parent-untouched
mutants.from:
case Some[ui.Id[E]] as p:
				touched[p.Value] = true
mutants.rule: a Set restyles its node (through its parent, which places it)

mutants.name: GPk-removed-box-stays
mutants.rule: a removed node's box leaves the kept tree

mutants.name: GPk-room-kept
mutants.from:
case Some[layout.Id] as l:
			restyle(d, l.Value, s)
mutants.rule: a list given room at a paint goes back to its own style before the next layout, as the rebuilt tree has it (hostagree's list app moves the list with its note)

mutants.name: GPk-metrics-learn-skipped
mutants.rule: learn measures each run of a text the table lacks, after the first text

mutants.name: GP2d-shortcut-without-ctrl
mutants.rule: a script's shortcut is the key pressed with its Ctrl

mutants.name: GP2d-shortcut-letters-unnamed
mutants.rule: the window gives a program a letter pressed with Ctrl, Alt or the system key (a shortcut types nothing)

mutants.name: GP2d-keys-to-the-focused-field
mutants.rule: a key of the editor's goes to the editor, after a click beside the toolbar drops a field's or a button's focus

mutants.name: GP2d-tasks-not-settled
mutants.rule: after each line the window settles the save or clipboard task the view asked for

mutants.name: GP2d-control-status-hidden
mutants.rule: the control's window shows the status line its frame measures

mutants.name: GP2d-control-moves-whole
mutants.rule: the control plays a move of N as N keys, as a window does (up and down keep the column of each line they leave)

mutants.name: GP3c-moves-not-captured
mutants.rule: a pressed pointer's moves go to the node it went down on, over any other node or none (pointer capture)

mutants.name: GP3c-outputs-unreported
mutants.rule: the window binary reports each of the tool's outputs once, after the line that made it

mutants.name: GP3c-control-buttons-everywhere
mutants.rule: the control's toolbar has no button for a layer, zoom or pan the Ergo view has none for, and says so as the scene does

mutants.name: GP4c-no-frames-asked
mutants.rule: a view that animates asks the window for its display's frames, and each frame is a tick of the session

mutants.name: GP4c-frames-not-drawn
mutants.rule: the headless window's display draws a frame for each frame the script moves

mutants.name: GP4c-notes-repeated
mutants.rule: each panel's note is printed once, after the frame that made it

mutants.name: GP4c-control-resume-ignored
mutants.rule: the control's pause button resumes a paused panel, as the Ergo view's does

mutants.name: wasm-node-env-inherits-gomaxprocs
mutants.rule: a js/wasm binary under node runs without the gate's GOMAXPROCS: the Go runtime on js/wasm dies in its start with newosproc when GOMAXPROCS is over 1

mutants.name: GPs-mask-every-frame
mutants.rule: a stroke's mask is keyed by its points and width alone, so the atlas keeps it while they do not change

mutants.name: GPs-no-discs
mutants.rule: a stroke's mask has a disc at each point, as each Line's rounded ends: caps and the outer side of turns

mutants.name: GPs-no-room
mutants.rule: when an atlas fills during a frame, draw makes room (MakeRoom) and builds the scene again, so a stroke's mask is not left out

mutants.name: GPm-present-headless
mutants.rule: a Headless window's frame stays in the renderer's image, which Pixel reads; it is not copied into a new buffer of the fake surface each frame

mutants.name: GPl-no-tiles
mutants.rule: a stroke's mask wider or taller than a tile draws as tiles, which the atlas holds, not one mask it leaves out

mutants.name: GPl-tile-not-moved
mutants.from: X: x0 + float32(ox), Y: y0 + float32(oy)
mutants.rule: each tile of a stroke's mask is drawn at its place in the mask

mutants.name: GPl-tile-all
mutants.rule: a stroke rasterizes only the tiles its segments come near

mutants.name: GPa-lists-new
mutants.rule: a list's text and accessibility nodes reuse the buffers of the list shown two frames before

mutants.name: GPa-points-new
mutants.from: w.strokes, w.pts, w.inStroke = w.strokes[:0], w.pts[:0], false
mutants.to: w.strokes, w.pts, w.inStroke = nil, nil, false
mutants.rule: a list's strokes and their points reuse the buffers of the list shown two frames before

mutants.name: GPa-access-always
mutants.rule: an accessibility tree that did not change is not published again

mutants.name: GPa-pix-new
mutants.rule: a stroke's mask is rasterized into one buffer, which the text system copies into its atlas

mutants.name: GPa-layout-not-kept
mutants.rule: a layout the window shaped is kept for the lists that use it

mutants.name: GPa-layouts-forgotten
mutants.rule: the layouts of the list made stay for the next one

mutants.name: GPa-layouts-kept-forever
mutants.rule: the window keeps the layouts of its last two lists only

mutants.name: GPo-pass-offset-ignored
mutants.to: if off != scrolledBy(d, id) && off != off {
mutants.rule: the window scrolls a list to the offset its pass wrote when that is not its own, so a RowsKeeping list shows the row it keeps

mutants.name: GPd-draws-every-node
mutants.rule: a paint draws anew only the nodes whose inputs changed; the rest take their last draw again

mutants.name: GPd-box-not-compared
mutants.rule: a node whose box moved is drawn anew

mutants.name: GPd-old-focus-kept
mutants.rule: the node that lost the focus is drawn anew, without its ring

mutants.name: GPd-set-not-soiled
mutants.rule: a node a pass set is drawn anew

mutants.name: GPd-insert-parent-not-soiled
mutants.from:
place(d, x.Id, x.Parent, x.Before)
			d.soiled[x.Parent] = true
			scrollTo(d, x.Id, x.Node)
		case ui.Move[E] as x:
mutants.to:
place(d, x.Id, x.Parent, x.Before)
			scrollTo(d, x.Id, x.Node)
		case ui.Move[E] as x:
mutants.rule: a parent a node was inserted under is drawn anew, with the new node

mutants.name: GPd-scroll-not-soiled
mutants.rule: a Scroll that moved is drawn anew at its offset

mutants.name: GPd-spots-not-kept
mutants.rule: a node that takes its last draw again keeps the spots it added, so hit tests find its nodes

mutants.name: GPd-text-not-moved
mutants.rule: a draw taken again keeps each line of text at its place among the ops
